settled.lesson: 5 recommendations: 0 target, 0 stop, 5 squared off; +10.8R in total. Best: SENSEX CE 79800 at 09:56 (+2.6R, ran 967 pts in favour). 3 squared-off trades reached 2R during the day and gave part of it back - the rules hold to 15:15 by design; the backtest says trailing earlier did not help. India VIX was 16.2 at the open. Carry forward: one trade per rule per day, the index-level stop decides, premium paths are shown so you can see where the plan and the option diverged.
